content.title: About
content.content: Prune juice is a 100% natural beverage made from ripe dried plums (prunes). It has a rich sweet‑tart flavor, deep burgundy color, and a distinctive aroma. The juice contains no added sugar, preservatives, or artificial colors.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Prunes have been used in cooking and traditional medicine for millennia.
Prune juice is often employed as a natural sweetener in baked goods and sauces.
Ancient cultures regarded prunes as a food that supports digestive health.
The juice retains most of the vitamins and minerals found in fresh plums thanks to minimal processing.
Prunes belong to the Rosaceae family and are closely related to plums, cherries, and apricots.

items.title: Rich in fiber
items.content: The juice provides both soluble and insoluble fiber, which supports regular bowel movements and helps regulate blood sugar levels.

items.title: Source of vitamin K
items.content: Vitamin K plays a role in blood clotting and bone health.

items.title: Contains potassium
items.content: Potassium helps maintain electrolyte balance, normal blood pressure, and muscle function.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Phenolic compounds and vitamin C in the juice combat free radicals, protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Prune juice is traditionally used to relieve constipation due to its natural laxative effect.

items.title: High natural sugar content
items.content: Even without added sugar, the juice contains natural sugars, so people with diabetes should monitor portion sizes.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The acidic nature of the juice may irritate the stomach lining in individuals with gastritis or ulcer disease.

items.title: Plum allergy
items.content: Rarely, an allergic reaction to plum components can occur.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Prune juice is relatively calorie‑dense; excessive consumption may contribute to weight gain.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Prune juice can be enjoyed on its own, added to smoothies, cocktails, sauces, and marinades. It is often used in diet plans to improve bowel regularity. Diluting with water is recommended if the flavor is too intense.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the juice in the refrigerator after opening, in a tightly sealed bottle, for up to 7‑10 days. Unopened packages should be kept in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
